name: Timber Saloon
description: A matching table and room: a rustic timber frontier saloon, warm oil lanterns, weathered wood floor, carved oak rail, aged tobacco-brown leather, deep bottle-green felt.

name: Riverboat Lounge
description: A matching table and room: an elegant riverboat gambling lounge, sunset through tall arched windows, warm brass lamps, polished mahogany rail, oxblood leather, burgundy felt.

name: Art Deco Club
description: A matching table and room: a glamorous 1920s Art Deco private club, geometric brass wall panels, emerald velvet, soft warm sconces, black lacquer table rail with gold inlays and deep emerald felt.

name: Neon Skyline
description: A matching table and room: a modern high-rise casino lounge at night, soft defocused city skyline and cyan magenta accent lights, graphite carbon table rail, muted cyan edge light and deep midnight teal felt.

name: Grand Casino
description: A matching table and room: an opulent grand casino, crystal chandeliers in warm bokeh, ivory marble and gold architectural details, highly polished champagne gold table rail with midnight blue leather and rich royal blue felt.
